provenance: RST-01 synthetic; owned [RST01-TEST] markers; alias table is illustrative, never a municipal census

rules.match: exact normalized name + UF against reference version; normalization is Unicode NFKD, strip diacritics, collapse whitespace, uppercase
rules.ambiguous: quarantine ambiguous_municipality with review reason; example SANTACRUZ without UF context matches several states
rules.unmatched: quarantine unknown_city; example VILLE INCONNUE has no reference entry
